methodBoundary.kmle: Direct KMLE HTML dictionary result pages opened for each query; values are from opened pages, not a search-engine snippet. Underlying exact edition is not exposed.

limits: KMLE exact underlying edition is not exposed by the opened pages.
Generic legacy term 중족골 intentionally returns both first and fifth metatarsals; cards retain distinct ordinal Korean and English names.
English landmark labels are preserved in internal bone records but suppressed from learner cards until Korean source-backed labels are available.
